sections.heading: Two pronouns in a row
sections.body:
When a sentence has both a direct and an indirect object, both can become pronouns: *Je donne le livre à Léa* → *Je le lui donne.* They always come in this order, before the verb:

- *Il me le prête.* (He lends it to me.)
- *Je te les envoie demain.* (I'll send them to you tomorrow.)
- *Elle la leur a montrée.* (She showed it to them.)
- *Je lui en ai parlé.* (I talked to him about it.)
- *Il y en a.* (There is / are some.)
- *Tu m'en donnes ?* (Will you give me some?)

Note: *le, la, les* go **before** *lui, leur* but **after** *me, te, nous, vous*.

sections.heading: Negative and compound tenses
sections.body: The block of pronouns stays together before the verb (before *avoir / être* in compound tenses), and *ne… pas* surrounds the whole block: *Je ne le lui ai pas dit.* (I didn't tell him.) *Ne me le dis pas !*

sections.heading: In positive commands
sections.body: In a positive imperative, the pronouns go after the verb, with **le / la / les first**, then the others: *Donne-le-moi !* (Give it to me!) *Envoie-les-lui.* *Donne-m'en.* (Give me some.) In the negative, back to normal order: *Ne me le donne pas.*

examples: Tu me prêtes ton vélo ? — Oui, je te le prête.
Will you lend me your bike? — Yes, I'll lend it to you.
J'ai donné le livre à Léa. Je le lui ai donné hier.
I gave the book to Léa. I gave it to her yesterday.
Je t'envoie les photos ? — Oui, envoie-les-moi.
Shall I send you the photos? — Yes, send them to me.
Elle a montré la maison à ses parents. Elle la leur a montrée.
She showed the house to her parents. She showed it to them.
Je lui en ai parlé ce matin.
I talked to him about it this morning.
Il y a encore du café ? — Oui, il y en a.
Is there any coffee left? — Yes, there is some.
Tu m'en donnes un peu ?
Will you give me a little?
Je ne le lui ai pas dit, c'est un secret.
I didn't tell him; it's a secret.
Rends-le-moi, s'il te plaît !
Give it back to me, please!
Ne me le dis pas, je ne veux pas savoir !
Don't tell me, I don't want to know!
Je te rendrai ta clé USB demain. Je te la rendrai demain.
I'll give you back your USB stick tomorrow.
Le document ? Je vous l'envoie tout de suite.
The document? I'll send it to you right away.
